description: This header file defines the EventQueue class used for scheduling and managing events in a firmware system. It includes functions for inserting tasks, executing scheduled events, and managing the event list. It uses templates, linked list structures, and references external scheduling and utility headers.

classes.name: EventQueue
classes.description: A class for managing a sorted linked list of scheduled events, supporting insertion, execution, and list management.

methods.name: insertTask
methods.description: Inserts a task into the event queue with specific scheduling parameters.

methods.name: executeAll
methods.description: Executes all scheduled tasks up to the current time.

methods.name: getNextEventTime
methods.description: Retrieves the time of the next scheduled event.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all events from the queue.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of events in the queue.

methods.name: getForUnitText
methods.description: Accesses an event at a specified index in the list.

methods.name: setLateDelay
methods.description: Sets the late delay value for the queue.

methods.name: getHead
methods.description: Returns the head of the event list.

methods.name: assertListIsSorted
methods.description: Checks if the list is sorted correctly.
